O.outcome_detail: knowledge of the target English phonemes

cells.quote: After performing a series of paired-sample t-tests for the data of pretest and posttest, the results of data analysis have shown that there was a significant difference in the mean scores between the pre-test and the post for both of the investigated variables, t (df =30) = 22.07 at p < .01 and t (df =30) = 44.17 at p < .01 respectively.
cells.note: The study reports a paired-sample t statistic and p value, but no effect size.
